definitions.explanation: The large white bear of the Arctic, which hunts seals on the sea ice. シロクマ ("white bear") is the everyday name; the zoological name is ホッキョクグマ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧シロクマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a polar bear at the zoo.
A polar bear is sleeping on the ice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧、シロクマ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧えさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アザラシ→アザラシ：06561_azarashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|と}り→捕る：28715_toru⟧にくく⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As the Arctic ice shrinks, it is getting harder for polar bears to catch the seals they feed on.

notes:
Also written {白熊|しろくま}. In Kagoshima, しろくま is also a famous shaved-ice dessert topped with condensed milk and fruit.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ホッキョクグマ: polar bear — the zoological name, used in science and on zoo signs
- ⟦ヒグマ→ヒグマ：32734_higuma⟧: brown bear
- ⟦ツキノワグマ→ツキノワグマ：32720_tsukinowaguma⟧: Asian black bear
